answers.text: Answered with a new item: call:civ/chapters/14_ch14.md:a69db048:note/tool1-concrete. Korea is removed. "In sound accounting" and "Single Ledger" are gone, and the passage ends on your sentence that claims about reality are always testable against reality. The two sentences you did not understand are replaced: the second step now uses the partisan's own excuses and says what is asked of them. One thing to tell me: the sentence "I observe that I'm often wrong on things I can check" is not in the draft or in any packet. The name asymmetrical accounting is kept because Tool 2 opens on it; say if it goes too.

Answered with a new item: call:civ/chapters/13_ch13.md:14d51098:note/red-green-ends-with-iran. The sentence you found poor is replaced by "Here is how their cooperation works." The march is named as its organizers named it, and your reason is in the passage in your words. The Qaradawi quotation is gone, and the passage ends with Iran. In place of homosexuality it names, from your own section 1, religious law, the place of women, and who commands after the common enemy falls.

Answered with a new item: call:civ/chapters/08_ch08.md:9547789f:note/kindness-streamlined. "The attempt fails for a plain reason" is gone; the failure is in the sentence that follows. Both alternates are built on the shorter version and each is streamlined to one claim a sentence, with the household and the agency said once.
